theory.intro: Fixture: a closed polygon drawn with a bare `-- cycle`. The closing edge runs (4,3) back to (0,0), a true length of 5, but is labelled 9 cm against a figure scale of 1 unit per cm. Before the TOKEN_RE fix a bare `cycle` was never tokenised as a point, so the closing edge was dropped, its label went unmatched, and the figure fell below the 3-matched-label floor and was skipped entirely.
